payload.claim: The comment cites "(§3)" for the claim that `failures_at_head` is the count before baseline subtraction. Bare `§N` elsewhere in this same file means `DESIGN.md`, and `DESIGN.md` §3 is "The unit of work: spec files" — it says nothing about baseline subtraction. The actual source is §3 of the record-on-git-refs design doc (`docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-20-the-record-on-git-refs-design.md`), and this file already has an established convention for that exact ambiguity at ledger.py:1348 ("§5 of the record design, not `DESIGN.md` §5"). This comment skips that disambiguation, so a reader following the convention is pointed at the wrong document's wrong section.
